supportDefinition: Destination-frame noMouseProbability >=0.85; no threshold on observed motion magnitude
verticalWeight: Above-bar cubic to 1 at barTop; 1 through beam; below-bar linear to 2 at half-depth then constant 2
colorbarDefinition: Vertical factor only; final pixel weight also multiplies column probability squared
interpretation: Measurement support, not anatomical tail segmentation or a contour of detected movement
